key: class above a sweet shop in Patna
name: ch31_patna_speaking_class
alt: A queue of office workers climbs the stairs to a speaking class above a sweet shop.
scene: A street-side view of a narrow two-storey building in Patna on a bright Sunday morning. On the ground floor, a sweet shop with an open front, a glass counter of laddoos and jalebis on trays and a striped awning; the shopkeeper in a white vest watches with mild curiosity. On the left side of the building an outdoor staircase climbs to the first floor, and on it stands a queue of four people waiting their turn: a bank clerk in his forties with a tie and a lunch bag, a shop owner in a kurta with a cloth bag, a young engineering graduate with a backpack and a file of certificates, and a young woman in a salwar suit holding a notebook. Nobody pushes them; they look eager and slightly nervous. Upstairs, through a wide open window, a small classroom is visible: a teacher points to a whiteboard while one student stands up at the front speaking, chest out, hand raised. A long hand-painted cloth banner hangs across the first floor above the window with a few painted stripes and no readable words. A small inset bubble near the queue shows the reason they came: an office meeting where one person stands and speaks while others listen, with a small arrow leading to a gold star. Warm morning light and a hopeful mood. Labels: "SPEAK UP" in large letters across the top of the picture, above the building.

key: An IIT topper joins a Bengaluru
name: ch31_topper_vs_batchmate
alt: Split picture: a topper works alone beside his rank certificate while his batchmate presents to a smiling team.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, inside a bright Bengaluru product company office with glass walls and plants. LEFT panel: the IIT topper, a young man in his mid-twenties with neat hair, spectacles and a grey hoodie, sits alone at a desk in front of two monitors full of code, headphones around his neck. A framed certificate on the desk reads "RANK 12". He looks up, a little puzzled, towards the right panel. The desks around him are empty. RIGHT panel: his batchmate from a smaller college, same age, in a teal shirt with rolled sleeves, stands at the front of a meeting room beside a screen showing a simple rising bar chart, one hand open towards his audience. Four colleagues and a client in a blazer sit around the table, smiling and nodding; one gives a thumbs-up. A small dashed arrow runs from the audience back to him, showing that people follow him. Both men are equally tidy, so the difference is only in what they are doing: one with his code, one with people. Clean daylight from big windows, calm mood. Labels: "TOPPER" at the top of the left panel and "TEAM" at the top of the right panel.

key: first day of a college fest committee
name: ch31_one_minute_intro
alt: A nervous student gives a one-minute introduction while a senior clinks a steel tumbler and the room laughs.
scene: A wide view of a college classroom on the first day of a fest committee, with paper bunting strung across the ceiling and the fest poster pinned to the board. In the centre-left, a nervous first-year student, a girl of about eighteen in a yellow kurta and jeans, stands in front of the class speaking with one hand raised, mid-sentence, a slightly sheepish smile. Right beside her, a senior student in a black committee T-shirt and a lanyard holds up a shiny steel tumbler in one hand and a steel spoon in the other, striking the rim; small sound-lines spring from the tumbler to show the clink. Above the tumbler a round clock badge shows a full one-minute circle with the hand at the top. Seated on benches in the foreground right, four students in casual clothes laugh warmly, one clapping, one covering her mouth, and a few more heads are implied behind them, as if thirty people fill the room. A dashed line of small speech dots runs from the speaker towards the audience and stops where the tumbler rings. The mood is light, friendly and noisy, with bright afternoon light through tall windows. Labels: "ONE MINUTE" in large letters at the top centre of the picture.

key: small town in Andhra gets his first job
name: ch31_lunch_table_invite
alt: Split picture: a new hire eats alone, then three months later tells stories at the centre of the lunch table.
scene: A split-panel illustration of the same cafeteria in a Hyderabad IT park, divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a young man of about twenty-three from a small town, in a slightly too-large light blue formal shirt and an ID card on a lanyard, sits alone at a small two-seat table with a steel lunch box, eyes down, shoulders hunched. In the background a group of four colleagues in trendy clothes laugh together at a long table. A small grey cloud bubble above him holds a tiny letter "A" with a question mark, showing his worry about his English. A teammate in a green T-shirt is walking over to him with a hand stretched out, and a dashed arrow runs from the teammate's hand to his shoulder. RIGHT panel: three months later, the same young man sits at the middle of the long table, leaning forward with both hands moving as he tells a story, grinning; the four colleagues around him laugh, one slapping the table. Behind them, a small whiteboard on the wall shows a calendar square with his ID-card icon on the "DEMO" day. Bright, warm light, cheerful mood. Labels: "WEEK 1" at the top of the left panel, "MONTH 3" at the top of the right panel.

key: A retired bank officer in a Pune housing
name: ch31_society_agm_question
alt: A quiet retired man stands up at a housing society meeting to ask for the accounts; an inset shows him as secretary next year.
scene: A view inside the community hall of a Pune housing society during the annual general meeting, with plastic chairs in rows, a ceiling fan and a long table at the front where the committee sits behind a white cloth. On the wall behind them, a notice board shows a pinned sheet with a big "+40%" and an upward arrow next to a small house icon. In the foreground left, a retired bank officer in his sixties, with grey hair, spectacles, a cream half-sleeve shirt and a pen in his pocket, has stood up from his chair, holding a printed accounts sheet and calmly pointing at one line with his pen. His face is composed, not angry. Around him, three seated residents (a woman in a sari, a young father, an elderly man with a walking stick) turn to look at him with surprise and respect. The committee member at the table holds up his palms awkwardly. A dashed arrow from the residents to him shows attention shifting his way. In the top right corner, a small inset bubble shows the next year: the same man sitting behind the committee table with a little name plate in front of him. Even indoor light, calm but tense mood. Labels: "ASK" above the standing man and "SECRETARY" above the inset bubble.

key: Indore namkeen brand has spent lakhs
name: ch31_namkeen_owner_stage
alt: Split picture: a namkeen packet on a hoarding that nobody looks at, then the owner speaking on stage, his clip going viral and distributors calling.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a busy Indore road with a big roadside hoarding showing a giant orange packet of namkeen with crunchy sev spilling out, no brand name readable. Below it, traffic and a scooter rider pass without looking up, and a small coin-bag with a rupee sign sits at the foot of the hoarding with a downward arrow, showing money spent. RIGHT panel: the same owner, a cheerful man in his fifties with a moustache, a white kurta and a sleeveless Nehru jacket, stands at a podium on a conference stage with a microphone, one hand open as he explains. A plain screen behind him shows a small shop and a delivery scooter icon. In front of the stage, two listeners in the audience lean forward. To the right, a large smartphone shows a video frame of him with a play triangle, surrounded by floating hearts and share arrows to show the clip spreading. Below the phone, a second phone is ringing with small vibration lines, held by a distributor in a checked shirt who is calling him. Bright stage light on the right, plain daylight on the left. Labels: "HOARDING" at the top of the left panel and "STAGE" at the top of the right panel.

name: ch31_crisp_update_halo
alt: At a monthly review, the clear presenter glows with a halo while the quiet engineer with deeper notes is ignored.
scene: A meeting room in a Delhi office at a monthly review, with a long table, a projector screen and a wall clock. On the left, a young woman in her late twenties in a coral kurta and trousers stands beside the screen giving a crisp update: the screen shows three neat bullet bars and a small green tick. A soft golden halo glows around her, and a small stopwatch icon near her shows five minutes. Seated at the table, the boss in a grey suit and two colleagues look at her and nod approvingly; one colleague has a small lightbulb above his head, as if thinking she must understand everything. On the far right end of the table sits a quiet engineer in his thirties in a plain grey shirt, with a laptop open and a tall stack of notebooks and printed diagrams beside him, more material than anyone else has. He is looking down at his work and nobody is looking at him. A faint dashed arrow from the audience goes only to the presenter and none goes to him. The mood is calm and ordinary, with cool office light. Labels: "CLEAR" above the presenter and "QUIET" above the engineer at the far end of the table.

key: A boy from a village in Vidarbha
name: ch31_village_to_world
alt: A dashed path climbs from a village boy watching his first train to the same man leading a training session in a big city.
scene: A wide picture that reads like a journey from left to right. On the bottom-left, a small Vidarbha village with mud-walled houses, a neem tree and dry fields; a boy of fourteen in a white shirt and khaki shorts stands on a tiny country platform watching a short blue train arrive, his eyes wide, carrying a cloth bag. From him a long dashed path with an arrowhead rises in a curve across the middle of the picture, passing small stepping-stones. On the upper-right, the same person as a grown man in his forties, in a navy blazer with a lanyard, stands before a whiteboard in a glass-walled training room with a city skyline of tall towers behind the window, three managers in suits sitting at a table taking notes. In the bottom-right corner, a small inset bubble shows a school staff room notice board with a pinned newspaper clipping that has a tiny photo of the man, and an old teacher in a sari smiling at it. Warm morning light on the village, cool bright light in the city. Labels: "VILLAGE" under the village scene at the bottom-left and "WORLD" above the city scene at the top-right.

name: ch31_day_scholar_debate
alt: A day scholar off the bus looks at two routes to fame on campus, cricket crossed out and the debate stage ticked.
scene: A college campus in Tamil Nadu in the morning. On the far left, a town bus has just stopped at the college gate and a first-year student, about eighteen, thin, in a slightly loose checked shirt with the sleeves too long, a cloth shoulder bag and a lunch tiffin, steps off. He stands looking at two places ahead of him. In the centre background, a cricket ground where two confident hostel students in white play, one hitting a ball high in the air; a red cross badge floats over the pitch, and a small thought bubble above the student shows a ball flying past a broken stump, showing he is hopeless at cricket. On the right, an auditorium stage with a podium and a big shining trophy on a table, and a banner with stripes but no words. A green tick badge floats over the stage, and a bold arrow runs from the student to the podium, showing the route he picks. A couple of other students in the right background clap at the stage. Bright morning light, determined mood. Labels: "CRICKET" above the cricket ground and "DEBATE" above the stage.

name: ch31_kochi_elocution
alt: A schoolgirl practises to coconut trees, her grandmother and a mirror, loses three years, wins the fourth and coaches juniors.
scene: A picture in two rows. TOP row: three small scenes side by side of the same girl, about twelve, in a white and blue Kerala school uniform with two plaited ribbons. First, she walks home on a red mud path between coconut trees, reciting with one arm out to the trees. Second, she stands in a kitchen reciting to her grandmother, a white-haired woman in a cream mundu with a gold border, who sits cutting vegetables on a curved blade and listens with a smile. Third, she stands at a bathroom mirror, practising a gesture. BOTTOM row: a timeline of four small certificates on a line marked with years; the first three have small red crosses, and the fourth is a gold trophy with a green tick. To the right of the trophy, the girl, a little older, stands at her front door with the trophy on a shelf behind her, while three smaller juniors in uniform wait on the step with notebooks, asking her to coach them. Soft green Kerala daylight, warm and hopeful mood. Labels: "PRACTICE" above the top row and "WIN" above the gold trophy.

name: ch31_rajasthan_sales_beat
alt: A sales rep hops off a rural bus to take orders at a kirana store; an inset bar chart shows her beat reach the top.
scene: A dusty rural road in Rajasthan under a bright, hot sky, with sand-coloured ground, a khejri tree and a low hill. On the left, an old village bus has stopped with a cloud of dust behind it, and the young sales rep, a woman in her mid-twenties in a navy salwar kameez, a dupatta and sneakers, with a shoulder bag and an order pad, is jumping down from its step. In the centre, a small kirana store with a tin shutter, sacks of grain and shelves of packets; the shopkeeper, a man in a white dhoti, kurta and a bright red turban, leans over his counter, listening, while she writes an order. Beside the store, a pile of old cartons has a small tag and a dashed arrow leads from it to a small tempo truck at the side, showing she found a bulk buyer for his old stock. In the top-right corner, a small inset bubble shows a bar chart of four beats, with the last bar, hers, rising tallest with a star on top. Harsh, warm sunlight with sharp shadows, busy and determined mood. Labels: "WEAKEST BEAT" at the top left above the road and "TOP" next to the tallest bar in the inset.

name: ch31_detours_to_workshop
alt: A young woman walks a winding path past a theatre stage and a car showroom, both crossed out, to a full workshop room she started.
scene: A winding path runs from left to right across the picture like a board game, with the same woman, in her late twenties with a short ponytail, walking along it. At the first stop on the left, a small theatre stage with red curtains and a spotlight: she stands at the side as an extra while another actor takes the centre; a small red cross badge floats above. At the second stop in the middle, a glass car showroom with a shiny hatchback; she stands beside it in a blazer and name badge, looking bored and tired; another red cross badge floats above. Between the second and third stop she stops on the path with a big question-mark thought bubble, and inside the bubble a tiny picture of a college debate podium. At the third stop on the right, a bright classroom on a weekend: she stands in front of a whiteboard teaching, and five freshers in casual clothes sit at desks, all chairs taken, one with a raised hand; a green tick badge floats above. The path is dashed between stops. Light warms from left to right, mood from unsure to confident. Labels: "THEATRE" above the first stop, "SALES" above the second stop and "WORKSHOP" above the third stop.

key: Chennai mess owner to let him start
name: ch31_biryani_profit_share
alt: In a Chennai mess at night, a cook and the owner shake hands over a biryani pot, with a one-third profit slice shown in a bubble.
scene: A busy Chennai mess in the evening, seen from the inside, with a dark window showing a crescent moon, yellow bulbs hanging over long steel tables and banana leaves laid out. On the right, a new weekend biryani counter: a large copper handi with its lid lifted, steam rising, a stack of plates and a small hand-written board with a drawing of a biryani pot. A queue of three hungry customers stands in front of it holding plates. In the centre, the young cook, in his early twenties with a white apron and a towel on his shoulder, shakes hands with the mess owner, a heavier man in his fifties in a white veshti, a half-sleeve shirt and a pen in his pocket, who looks slightly doubtful but agrees. Above their handshake, a round inset bubble shows a pie chart cut into three equal parts, with one slice pulled out and a small stack of coins on that slice. A dashed arrow leads from the queue of customers to the coin stack, showing the counter's profit growing his share. On the far left, a quiet ordinary meals counter with no queue. Warm, yellow, lively evening light, hopeful mood. Labels: "1/3 PROFIT" above the pie-chart bubble.

name: ch31_swim_first_day
alt: Learners in a municipal pool hold the edge and let go for three seconds while a coach with a whistle counts.
scene: A side cross-section view of a municipal swimming pool in Ahmedabad in the early summer morning, with blue water, tiled edges and lane ropes of red and white floats. On the deck on the left, a strict but kind coach in his forties in a white T-shirt, shorts and a whistle on a cord, crouches at the edge holding up three fingers. In the water, four learners of different ages in swimming caps: a boy holding the edge with both hands, a middle-aged man letting go and floating for a moment with arms out and puffed cheeks, a girl splashing with water drops flying, and a teenager mid-stroke halfway across the width with a dashed arrow ahead of him to the far wall. Nobody is laughing at anyone; one learner gives another a thumbs-up. On a bench in the back, a closed book of swimming strokes lies unused with a small red cross on it. In the top-right corner, a small inset bubble shows the same middle-aged man at summer's end, jumping in confidently with a big splash. Bright morning sun and sparkling water, encouraging mood. Labels: "GET IN" in large letters at the top centre of the picture.

name: ch31_workshop_group_meetup
alt: Old workshop friends meet at a café on the first Saturday, one arriving with a suitcase, one rehearsing a work problem.
scene: A cosy Bengaluru café on a Saturday morning, with filter-coffee tumblers, a big window with green trees outside and a wall calendar. Around a long wooden table sit five friends in their late thirties: a woman in a mustard kurta, a man with a beard in a denim shirt, a woman with short hair and glasses, and an older man in a polo shirt; they are turned towards the fifth friend, a woman in a blazer standing at the head of the table rehearsing a presentation, holding up a sheet of paper, while the others listen and one takes notes. On the left, entering through the café door, a man in a jacket pulls a small cabin suitcase with an airline tag, waving hello, just arrived from Hyderabad; a dashed arrow with a tiny plane icon comes from the window edge to him. On the wall, a calendar page shows one square circled in red as the first Saturday. On the table, one phone lies face-up showing a group chat with several message bubbles and a small number badge. Warm golden morning light, friendly and loyal mood. Labels: "EVERY MONTH" in large letters at the top centre of the picture.

name: ch31_grandmother_diary
alt: A granddaughter reads her late grandmother's account diary, where margin notes about helping people glow brighter than the sums.
scene: A close, warm view in an old Kolkata home with green wooden shutters, a ceiling fan and a framed photo of an elderly woman in a white sari with a red border on the wall, kept with a small garland. In the foreground, a young woman in her twenties in a simple cotton kurta sits on a cane chair and holds open a large, worn diary with a cloth cover. The diary is drawn big and clear: the left page shows neat columns of household sums with rupee-style lines (rice, milk, gas) and faint figures; the right page's wide margin has small handwritten notes, each with a tiny icon beside it, a little exam form, and two small stick figures shaking hands under a Durga Puja lamp. A soft glow highlights the margin notes, and a dashed arrow runs from the notes up to the young woman's smiling face. Behind her, her mother leans over her shoulder, pointing at one note, moved. Late-afternoon light through the shutters, nostalgic and tender mood. Labels: "ACCOUNTS" above the left page of the diary and "PEOPLE" above the right page.
